purpose: Falsification attack on role-flory-gelation-v1's anti-circularity claim: that its local Python SMARTS-based (f,g) functionality re-derivation is a faithful stand-in for the module's own real production RDKit C++ FFI ground truth. Attacked with the guanidine/amidine N-H chemotype (twice already refuted against sibling artifacts in this module: amine-nh-guanidine-conjugation-gap-v1, role-guanidine-accelerator-domain-probe-v1), which the flory-gelation fixture (24 single-role records) contains zero examples of.

summary.finding: 5/6 probes: role-flory-gelation-v1's local Python SMARTS re-derivation disagrees with live production RDKit FFI ground truth on the reactive-amine-hydrogen count. The local SMARTS `!$(N=*)` excludes only the single nitrogen directly carrying the formal C=N double bond, not the broader Y-delocalized-resonance guanidine/amidine exclusion the real production backend implements after the R-N02/W-FFI2 repairs. 3/6 probes additionally FLIP the downstream Flory network-adequacy grade: guanidine, biguanide, and n-methylguanidine (the pinned production test suite's own adversarial narrowness control) are graded 'network_former' by the local re-derivation when live production ground truth (reactive_amine_hydrogen_count=0 for all three) says they cannot react with an epoxide at all, so the correct grade is 'non_network_former'. The flory-gelation fixture's 24 single-role records contain zero guanidine-class molecules, so this divergence between the module's own claimed 'anti-circular' re-derivation and its own real production ground truth has never been exercised, despite the module already knowing (from two prior REFUTED ledger entries) that this exact chemotype breaks naive amine-H SMARTS.
